name: Toice Bhrean
sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Toice Bhrean is a figure of Irish folk. She is a fairy housekeeper who knits at the floor of a lake. Her name holds the words for slattern and lazy. She left the lid of a well open, and the water rose to form the lake. She goes out of the day and sees the sun of the surface once in seven years.

okr.objective: Record the keeper of the lake in the tales.
key_results: She knits at the floor of a lake
